title: Target desktop-only local use
decision: Archivist should target desktop-only local use for v1. Mobile layout and mobile smoke validation are not product requirements.
context: The app is a one-person local browser/workbench now and will be shared as local desktop copies for coworkers working on complex policy/manual content.
rationale: Desktop-only scope lets the port prioritize dense document navigation, review panels, chat, diff inspection, history, and export without spending early effort on mobile constraints that the user does not need.
alternatives_considered: Keep mobile-responsive behavior as a first-class target
Build a browser-agnostic responsive app before porting old features
consequences: Validation should focus on desktop viewports and Chrome/Chromium local launcher behavior
The UI can favor dense multi-pane layouts
Mobile media queries may exist incidentally but should not drive design decisions
Future mobile support would be a separate scope decision
